diffeomorphism_ward_contract.action_invariance: the complete parent action EH+GHY+scalar+Maxwell+localized cap is invariant under a common infinitesimal spacetime diffeomorphism with the induced interface transformation
diffeomorphism_ward_contract.ward_identity_abstract: Integral_Sigma beta*R_perp + N_perp[bulk Euler-Lagrange residuals, metric/scalar/gauge/phase junction residuals; beta] = 0 for arbitrary compactly supported common normal gauge parameter beta
diffeomorphism_ward_contract.operator_N_perp: the orientation-safe linear functional generated by integration by parts of the regional diffeomorphism variation; its full component reduction is deliberately not frozen here

the complete component passive-force equation is not yet released

passive_equation_status.generic_asymmetric_two_side_expectation: a normal/passive shell equation is a real consistency channel in a generic asymmetric gluing and must not be deleted by invoking Israel alone

independent_controls.finite_dimensional_gauge_model: for S(q,X)=0.5*(q-X)^2, simultaneous translation q->q+a, X->X+a gives E_q+E_X=0 identically; therefore the shape-like residual E_X vanishes when the field residual E_q vanishes, but not off shell
independent_controls.multi_residual_linear_algebra: for an invariant differentiable S(y) with infinitesimal generator R, grad(S) dot R=0; solving all but one residual along a nonzero generator component determines the remaining residual
independent_controls.israel_alone_negative_control: a synthetic residual vector with R_h=0 but nonzero bulk residual is allowed to have nonzero R_perp while satisfying the Ward identity, proving Israel-only redundancy is forbidden
independent_controls.orientation_control: one common beta maps to beta_N=+beta and beta_S=-beta under the merged collar identification
